name: koala-residual-verify-gate-and-cleanup
title: Koala residual verify gate: catalog all remaining koala hits + clean up real misses
description: Pre-open-source final verify gate for the Koala-removal program (after B-d313/B-0b26/B-08f2/B-747e/B-d7ef/B-ed70). Run a comprehensive `git grep -i koala` audit, classify every remaining hit into documented exception categories (the 7 from memory: .koala/ runtime paths, LEGACY_KOALA_* constants, signature salts, framework-audit, managed-assets denylist, CHANGELOG/history, koala-to-lattice-role-naming plan), document any newly-discovered legitimate exception categories (decision-doc historical design references, smoke-test mkdtemp prefixes that test koala-Lattice rebrand regression, .githooks self-host-detection by npm package name), and clean up the genuine missed-cleanup hits (audit doc still teaching KOALA_AUTHORITY_* env vars that B-08f2 already renamed; .gitignore entries for deleted packages; NAV.md titles; etc.). Output: a verify-gate report committed to docs/requirements/decisions/ that future contributors can use to confirm no NEW koala creep before each OSS release, plus the cleanup commits for any real misses found.
